title: Solid Waste Management
notes: **Solid Waste Management:** This topic covers the fundamental concepts of solid waste management in the biology curriculum.
Understanding solid waste management is essential for solving problems and building higher-level mathematical skills.
Key definitions and theorems related to solid waste management should be memorized and practiced regularly.

universalFacts: This topic is a cornerstone of the biology curriculum and appears consistently in examinations.
